content:
kevin: Starting bring-up for rho3b-int4 tomorrow AM. need a compact promptset that stresses structured-preservation (JSON, CSV, tables) and locale code-mix.
sara: agree. propose micro-golden=600, review pool=1400, anchors=150 separate.
lio: dedupe plan: exact token first (0.95) then semantic clusters (cos>=0.82 using tok-v4-embed). keep intent variants.
marta: add formatting-preserve partition (200) specifically for structured outputs. those regressed last int4.
labelops-bot: LabelOps: 1.4k/day. double-review for golden recommended. Reserve slots?
kevin: reserve. workflow: sample -> normalize (nfkc+trim) -> dedupe -> split -> synthetic flag -> golden double-review -> adjudicate. owner: sara.
sara: timeline: start 09:00 UTC, 60h window. escalate to kevin if disagreement>18%.
lio: include 120 adversarial formatting examples (malformed JSON, nested tables) and 70 long prompts (>1500 tokens) to stress kv cache.
marta: also include tokenization-variant checks (bpe vs unigram) and token-level diffs; small span shifts were the hardest to debug.
eval-bot: sampling config suggestion:
mode: compact_focus
locales: ["pt_BR","ko","ru","en-IN","es-MX"]
min_tokens: 15
max_tokens: 2000
semantic_dedupe: 0.82
exact_dedupe: 0.95
adversarial_count: 120
format_preserve_count: 200
long_seq_count: 70
golden_count: 600
labelpool_count: 1400
exclude_lists: ["holdout_main_2025","rho_anchor_v1"]
labelops-bot: Golden policy: double-review; adjudicate if disagreement >=15%; escalate owner if >=25%. Slots reserved starting 09:00 UTC.
sara: I'll upload normalized seeds to s3://curation/rho3b/struct-preserve-2025 and attach provenance.json.
kevin: can someone wire a smoke harness to run crit-rate + format-preserve-accuracy + tokenizer-delta vs rho3b-fp16 and rho3b-int8? want per-locale and per-partition breakdowns.
eval-bot: queued. snippet: ./eval/run --models rho3b-fp16,rho3b-int8,rho3b-int4 --dataset s3://curation/rho3b/struct-preserve-2025/micro-golden.json --metrics crit_rate,format_acc,tokenizer_delta --out /tmp/rho3b-smoke
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: 2025-10-01T06:00:00Z -> rho3b-int4 staging-pool. Notifying #eng-runtime.
lio: also run quant-bias checks (numeric formatting, date localization, entity replacement). small systematic shifts matter.
marta: final checklist: normalized upload, dedupe lists, format-preserve partition, labelops reserved, harness queued, canary scheduled. If no blockers we proceed. :rocket:
sara: lgtm. will post promptset link after upload.
